# 真唯識量略解

**ID:** X0862

**Category:** 論集部類
**Original Category:** 大小乘釋論部／因明論疏
**Byline:** 明 智旭略解
**Dynasty:** 明
**Date:** 1368–1644
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/X0862

## Contributors
- 智旭 (A001257)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A short late-Míng / early-Qīng one-*juǎn* commentary by [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD) (Zhìxù / Ǒuyì 蕅益, 1599–1655) on [玄奘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%84%E5%A5%98) (Xuánzàng)'s famous *Zhēn-wéishí liàng* 真唯識量 — the syllogism by which Xuánzàng is said to have established the Yogācāra thesis at the eighteen-day council of Kanyākubja under Harṣa. Like Míngyù's *Sān zhī bǐ liàng yì chāo* [KR6o0035](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6o/KR6o0035), Zhìxù starts from the passage in Yánshòu's *Zōngjìng lù* and offers a careful philosophical exposition; but he goes further than Míngyù in providing a structural outline (序述, 正明, 結歎) and treating the syllogism as an exemplar of the entire Cí'ēn / Fǎxiàng *yīnmíng* method.

**Abstract**

The colophon "唐奘師真唯識量略解 / 宋永明壽禪師宗鏡錄中節出 / 明藕益釋智旭略解" identifies the three layers: Xuánzàng's original (Táng), Yánshòu's *Zōngjìng lù* excerpt (Sòng), and Zhìxù's commentary (Míng). The structure is in three parts: (1) 敘述 (narrative — the historical setting at Kanyākubja); (2) 正明 (proper exposition — the syllogism analysed as 宗-因-喻); (3) 結歎 (concluding praise). Zhìxù treats the syllogism as a paradigm case of how the Cí'ēn / Fǎxiàng method must use the very precise restrictions on *parārthaanumāna* (other-directed inference), and especially the *zìxǔ* 自許 (self-conceded) and *biǎnshì* 遍是 conventions, to prevent the syllogism from collapsing into self-contradiction. Composition is in Zhìxù's mature period at Línshān 靈山 in Zhèjiāng, c. 1635–1655. The work is a much shorter and more accessible companion to his *Yīnmíng rù zhèng lǐ lùn zhí jiě* [KR6o0029](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6o/KR6o0029) and was used as introductory teaching material in early-Qīng Buddhist seminaries.
